To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) Open IE can be used as an intermediate layer in text summarization, (ii) Open IE can improve the coverage, coherency and quality of the summary, (iii) The proposed system is able to extract the main idea of the sentence and eliminate less important parts of the sentence, (iv) The proposed approach can be adopted to different languages.
(a) open information extraction as an intermediary layer can improve the quality of the summary, and (b) it can be used as an effective method to produce a summary for the Persian language.
Open IE is a good candidate for text summarization and can be adopted to Persian and other languages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a new form of text summarization that is based on the extraction of the most significant substructures of a sentence.
a novel approach to text summarization that is based on the extraction of machine-understandable semantic propositions from a text.
a new application of Open Information Extraction for Persian text summarizing and it is the first work in this direction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system is able to produce a summary with a higher coverage and a higher coherency.
Open IE can be used as an intermediate layer to generate a summary of a text.
the proposed method can produce a more informative and more readable summary than other state-of-the-art systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how Open IE can be applied as a novel approach to text summarization.
the system can be a good candidate for summarization of Persian documents.
the proposed method can be a useful tool in the field of text summarization, especially for the Persian language.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Open IE can provide a good starting point for summarization.
Open IE is a useful and practical tool for text summarization and can be applied to other applications.
Open IE can be used to improve the quality of summaries by eliminating redundant pieces of information.
